name: halftone-field
title: Halftone Field
description: A full-bleed halftone light field on the brand ground: a grid of dots whose size and colour track a slow flowing simplex-noise field, so broad bands of grey, red and white light sweep across a mostly dark frame like an LED wall. Built to run under type. Palette, cell size, flow and cues are variables; holds 30 s or fades.
